title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・情けねえあたし

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One loses the autumn Tenno Sho. Her dream of becoming Umamusume of the Year is so far away now that she's losing hope.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap and Super Creek on the other hand are as composed as ever. It's clear their strength is on another level compared to Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the Arima Kinen. Determined to crush Oguri Cap and Super Creek in an overwhelming victory, Inari One throws herself into training until she winds up collapsing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The intense pressure to win for the sake of the people of Oi has placed such a huge mental burden on her that she's reached her limit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, she's so ashamed that she can't even bring herself to face the people of her hometown. I've never seen her so downtrodden…
